shared_elements: tall upright carved stone monolith standing in situ
relief carving covering the vertical face
stacked registers/tiers of motifs read from top to bottom
animal or creature heads shown frontally and in profile
horizontal banded divisions between motif zones
loose rubble and broken stone blocks at the base
justification: Both show a tall upright slab whose face is divided into vertically stacked registers of creature heads and disc-like eyes, set in loose rubble at its foot, which gives a genuinely similar overall silhouette and reading order. The rendering differs sharply, however: A is shallow, sparse, outline-like carving with wide blank ground recorded photographically, while B is dense, deeply undercut, horror-vacui ornament reproduced as a fine-line engraving complete with a seated human figure for scale.
